## Example 2.3 · Finding the annual rate {#fm2-example-2-3 .fm-slide }

What annual simple interest rate is required for \$8000 to earn \$1120 in 28 months?

<p class="booklet-cue">Booklet p. 6 · Example 2.3 · Complete your working in the booklet.</p>

::: notes
$N=28/12=7/3$ years. $R=1120/[8000(28/12)]=0.06$. The annual rate is 6% p.a. Avoid rounding 28/12 early.
:::
